	        <div style="float:left; width:100%;" id="post-2001" class="post-2001 page type-page status-publish hentry">
	            <div class="wpb-content-wrapper"><div data-vc-full-width="true" data-vc-full-width-temp="true" data-vc-full-width-init="false" data-vc-stretch-content="true" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid w-overlay vc_custom_1659183719649 vc_row-has-fill vc_row-no-padding"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"> <h1 style="color:#ffffff;padding:px;text-align:center;font-size:50px;line-height:px;letter-spacing: px;font-weight:lighter" class="  text-50  ">ACCOMMODATION</h1> </div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row-full-width vc_clearfix"></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1657971049141"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-8"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element" >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><span class="nicdark_font_size_70 nicdark_float_left nicdark_padding_28 nicdark_line_height_30 nicdark_first_font">H</span>abagat Kiteborading Center offers accommodation through its sister company, Aissatou Beach Resort, which is one of the chillest places to stay in Boracay.</p>
<p>Aissatou Beach Resort stands in the south part of Bulabog Beach, surrounded by palm trees and abundant of island decor. The resort staff radiate a welcome island warmth that guests love for the home-away-from-home vibe.</p>
<p>The fact that Aissatou is situated Bulabog beach ( a 10 minute walk away from the crowded white beach) adds to its calm and undisturbed appeal.</p>
<p>Equipped with 2 modern Penthouse Apartments with to die for view and equally stunning Deluxe and Superior rooms where guest have a choice of sea view or garden view. All rooms are identical starting from the lay out down to the furniture.<br />
Aissatou Beach Resort has been home to kitesurfers since 2006 and is under German management.</p>
		</div>
	</div>
